statement: A generic real hypersurface of degree 2n-3 in RP^n has finitely many real lines and at least (2n-3)!! of them. More generally, if all real lines are isolated, the sum of the absolute local Euler indices of the induced symmetric-power tautological-bundle section is at least (2n-3)!!. The signed Euler count equals this double factorial.

answer.qualification: Ordinary counts require regular isolated real lines; multiplicity/index variants cover further cases.

scope: Generic real degree 2n-3 hypersurfaces in RP^n, with n the ambient dimension (the paper uses dimension n-1 instead).
notes: Catalogue n is ambient projective dimension; source writes ambient P^(n+1), degree2n-1. The lower bound need not be sharp. Local Euler-index multiplicities differ from the algebraic multiplicities of Okonek–Teleman.
